response: Orthostatic myoclonus is indeed an underrecognized cause of unsteadiness, particularly in individuals with neurodegenerative diseases. It is often underdiagnosed, and electromyography surface recording can be a helpful tool in investigating unsteadiness of unknown origin. This condition should be considered as a possible cause of unsteadiness in patients with neurodegenerative diseases, and further evaluation using electromyography may be necessary to determine the underlying cause of unsteadiness.
